_comment: Experience timeline entries. Displayed in ExperienceSection.

bullets: Built 6+ API endpoints for an HRMS: employee onboarding, roles and access control.
Built a shopping cart, wishlist and product filters in React. Moved the filter state into one context so it no longer gets passed down through 3 levels of components.
Wrote shared request-validation middleware with consistent error responses, so each module stopped repeating the same checks.
Built a leaderboard API with MongoDB aggregations, so ranking happens in the database instead of in app code.
Cut database round trips by 50% in interview scheduling by rewriting the queries with aggregation joins.
Moved auth tokens to httpOnly cookies, added CSRF checks, and put Redis-backed rate limiting on the API.
